capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Wikipedia: 2014 pack is 21.3 kWh LiFePO4 (A123). Nominal, treated as gross.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: No page gives usable energy for the 2014 21.3 kWh LFP pack. Applied the published usable/nominal ratio of the 2015-16 Spark EV pack (18/19, GreenCarsCompare): 21.3 x 18/19 = 20.2. WEAK: different cells (LFP vs the later Li-ion pack).

chemistry.notes: Wikipedia: 21.3 kWh lithium iron phosphate pack supplied by A123 Systems (2014).

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: Auto-data lists the Spark EV battery at 400 V; no 800 V production car existed before 2019.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Absence of mention: Wikipedia describes only a liquid thermal management system and no battery warm-up feature; GM's navigation-based preconditioning appears only on the 2022+ Ultium cars (2027 Bolt release). No page states that the Spark EV lacks preconditioning.

dc_max_kw.notes: Wikipedia: optional CCS Combo 1 at 50 kW DC, 80 % in 20 minutes; EVSpecs and GreenCarsCompare agree on 50 kW. DC was optional: cars without it have no DC port.

ac_max_kw.notes: Wikipedia: maximum 3.3 kW onboard charger (EVSpecs 3.84 kW at 240 V).
